universalQuestions.text: Have you clearly defined your value proposition?
universalQuestions.help: A clear value proposition explains what problem you solve and why customers should choose you

universalQuestions.text: What is your estimated Total Addressable Market (TAM)?
universalQuestions.help: TAM represents the total market demand for your product or service

universalQuestions.text: Do you have a clear competitive differentiation?
universalQuestions.help: What makes your solution unique compared to competitors?

universalQuestions.text: Have you validated your revenue model?
universalQuestions.help: A validated revenue model has paying customers or proven willingness to pay

universalQuestions.text: How well do you understand your competitors?
universalQuestions.help: Competitive analysis helps identify opportunities and threats

universalQuestions.text: What is your current product development stage?
universalQuestions.help: Your development stage indicates technical progress and risk

universalQuestions.text: Is your technology stack scalable?
universalQuestions.help: Scalability determines your ability to grow user base without major rewrites

universalQuestions.text: Have you conducted security assessments?
universalQuestions.help: Security is critical for user trust and regulatory compliance

universalQuestions.text: Do you have any intellectual property (IP)?
universalQuestions.help: IP can provide competitive advantages and increase company valuation

universalQuestions.text: What is your data/analytics infrastructure?
universalQuestions.help: Data-driven decisions accelerate product-market fit

universalQuestions.text: How many customer discovery interviews have you conducted?
universalQuestions.help: Customer interviews validate problem-solution fit

universalQuestions.text: How many paying customers do you have?
universalQuestions.help: Paying customers validate market demand and willingness to pay

universalQuestions.text: What is your customer retention rate?
universalQuestions.help: High retention indicates product-market fit and customer satisfaction

universalQuestions.text: Have you achieved product-market fit?
universalQuestions.help: PMF is when customers would be very disappointed without your product

universalQuestions.text: Do you have a clear customer acquisition strategy?
universalQuestions.help: A repeatable acquisition strategy is essential for growth

universalQuestions.text: How many full-time team members do you have?
universalQuestions.help: Team size indicates execution capacity and organizational maturity

universalQuestions.text: What is your team's relevant industry experience?
universalQuestions.help: Domain expertise accelerates product development and market understanding

universalQuestions.text: Do you have advisors or a board?
universalQuestions.help: External guidance provides strategic insights and credibility

universalQuestions.text: Have you established key partnerships?
universalQuestions.help: Strategic partnerships can accelerate growth and provide resources

universalQuestions.text: Do you have defined processes and workflows?
universalQuestions.help: Operational efficiency enables scaling without chaos

universalQuestions.text: What is your current monthly revenue (MRR/ARR)?
universalQuestions.help: Revenue demonstrates market validation and business viability

universalQuestions.text: Have you created a financial model?
universalQuestions.help: Financial modeling helps forecast growth and funding needs

universalQuestions.text: Do you understand your unit economics?
universalQuestions.help: Unit economics (LTV:CAC ratio) determine profitability potential

universalQuestions.text: What is your current funding status?
universalQuestions.help: Funding stage indicates resources available and investor confidence

universalQuestions.text: What is your current runway (months of cash)?
universalQuestions.help: Runway determines urgency and strategic options
